Hi! I have never been here before. What is DeskAtlas and how does it work?

DeskAtlas

DeskAtlas is the customer-facing reference system for SKYDY Study Hub & Coworking Space, providing workspace suitability, pricing, and policy guidance. It is not a live booking engine or price database; actual availability, booking quotes, and reservation outcomes are determined by official channels and authenticated transactions. To get started, visit the venue at RM101 Square, 3rd Floor, Manila, or contact SKYDY via its official Facebook page and Messenger. For reservations, use the website or on-site kiosk, where map availability labels indicate potential eligibility but do not hold inventory until confirmed. Staff verification is required for walk-ins and payment processing.

response:

How do I book and pay? Do I need an account, and when is my desk actually confirmed?

DeskAtlas

No account is required. On the website, select a workspace, date, and time, then submit your name and email. You will receive a private payment link with a 60-minute deadline to upload proof of transfer. A pending status or payment upload does not hold inventory or confirm your desk.

Your desk is only confirmed after an administrator reviews your proof and the system assigns a specific physical unit. You will receive a final confirmation email identifying the exact workspace and schedule. Until that email arrives, your booking is not secured.

question: What if my plans change or I arrive late? Can I cancel, move the booking, or get a refund?
response:
You

What if my plans change or I arrive late? Can I cancel, move the booking, or get a refund?

DeskAtlas

To cancel or reschedule, you must request at least 24 hours before your start time; same-day changes are not accepted under the standard rule. If eligible, cancellations qualify for a 50% refund of the verified payment base, subject to authorized approval. Late arrivals do not extend your session end time.

To move your booking, you must request an authorized amendment via the front desk or official Messenger with your reference and reason. Staff will check availability and price differences; you must wait for a revised confirmation before occupying a new space. Chat requests cannot relocate confirmed bookings.

For emergencies or business-initiated issues, staff will review the specific case under approved policy. Do not assume automatic waivers or refunds. Retain your booking reference and original payment receipt, and share these through verified private channels for resolution.
